title: 第四章 九劫剑的秘密
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
似乎是一个饿得不行了的婴儿，在使劲的乱蹬着腿嗷嗷哭闹着要吃奶的那种感觉。楚阳被自己心中泛起的这种感觉汗了一下，实在不知道这种离谱的感觉是怎么产生的。
意念一接触，那暗淡的九劫剑影发出一种淡淡的抗拒和好奇，似乎一个婴儿，在睁着无辜的眼睛看着自己，眼神里面有渴望，有陌生，还有期待……
楚阳心中没来由的泛起一阵怜爱，轻柔得用自己的意念包裹过去……这次那剑影只是轻微的抗拒了一下，就解除了防备。
意念的接触之下，楚阳却也明白了这东西是怎么来的！
这并不是九劫剑；确切的说，这是九劫剑的剑魂！或者说是剑意！
就是自己在施展毁灭那一招的时候，将九劫剑刺进了自己的心脏，心血浇灌，激发了剑魂。也等于是激发了九劫剑之中最大的秘密的开端……
而就是这激发的剑魂，不知怎么回事，竟然带着自己又回到了少年时刻！
九劫剑最后一招，本就是禁忌之招。与敌偕亡，而且，先杀己，再杀敌！唯有存有这样的决绝意念，才能施展出来！
楚阳不知道的是，这正是九劫剑神秘之处之一！
历任九劫剑主，都只是按照修剑的道路去修炼；而得不到九劫剑的认可！因为，完全将自己当做一柄剑来修炼……那么，会得到的是什么？
剑，本就是无情的。所以他们在这样的驱使之下，自然而然的就会选择无情剑道！
所以，历届九劫剑主，不过都是“剑奴”！包括楚阳的前世，也只是剑奴而已！剑的奴隶！
是剑在用人，而不是人在用剑！
但楚阳却使出了最后一招，以我心血，崩毁万劫！
除了楚阳之外，历届得到九劫剑的人从来无人敢使出这一招！而等他们寿元到了终限或者意外被人杀死，九劫剑就会自动分解，再度回归残片状态，散落在大陆各处，静静地等待着真正的主人，期待有朝一日，可以登上九劫剑辉煌的巅峰，开启它真正神圣的宿命……
所以，楚阳者不顾一切的最后一招，才导致了剑魂完全激活，住进他的丹田，而这九重天大陆的第一神物，也从那时候开始，才真正的有了主人！
所以它也才会这么轻易的接受楚阳。
可以说，除了创造九劫剑的人之外，楚阳，才是九劫剑第一任主人！
名副其实的，九劫剑主。
这才是真正的，置之死地而后生！

从这一刻开始，楚阳清晰的知道，自己将走上与前世截然不同的道路！
现在，这九劫剑的剑魂，就像一个嗷嗷待铺的婴儿，正在迫切的需要九劫剑各个碎片和这天地灵气的滋养！所发出的这种迫切的情绪，也正是催着楚阳去找寻九劫剑的残片！找寻九劫剑需要的营养……
楚阳的心神沉入丹田，用自己的心神，将那柄黯淡的剑魂包住，全心全意的付出抚慰之意……
过了一会，九劫剑意似乎感受到了楚阳的真心，慢慢地安静下来，虽然还是有些不情不愿的意思，但却不再发出那种渴望的召唤了……
似乎一个得不到心爱玩具的小孩子，却又懂事的不再强行吵闹，只是扁着嘴，含着泪花儿，委屈的注视着自己的父母……
这个九劫剑魂，倒像是一个小孩子一般惹人怜爱。
楚阳心中浮起一阵怜惜之意，在这样的情绪之下，居然心中有一股惭愧的意思冒上来……
控制住兴奋的情绪，长长舒了一口气。睁开眼睛，却看见石千山正在自己面前看着自己，眼眸深处，竟然有丝丝兴奋。想必是以为楚阳出现这样异常乃是受伤所致。见楚阳睁开眼，那眼底的兴奋一闪而逝，却关切的道：“楚师弟，你怎么了？”
“没事。只不过……刚才突然有些想放屁，额……不过顾及到大师兄你就在跟前，没好意思，使了好大的劲才憋回去了……”楚阳意味深长的看了看石千山，认认真真地道。
“呃……”石千山脸色一变，讪讪地道：“这个……很难受的吧……”一时间也不知道怎么回答，究竟是劝他放出来好呢……还是就这么憋着……
貌似都不合适啊……
一边的谈昙噗的一声笑了起来，但却又觉得不合时宜，不敢放声大笑，再加上他声音独特，导致了笑的这声音，居然真的像是放了一个屁一般的沉闷……

content_en:
It seemed like the feeling of a starving baby, kicking its legs and crying for milk. Chu Yang sweated at the feeling in his heart. He really didn't know how this outrageous feeling came about.
As soon as the thought comes into contact, the dim Nine Tribulations Sword Shadow emits a faint resistance and curiosity, as if a baby is looking at itself with innocent eyes, with longing, strangeness, and expectation in its eyes...
Chu Yang's heart felt a burst of affection for no reason, and he wrapped it up with his own thoughts... This time, the sword shadow only resisted slightly, and then released its guard.
With the contact of thoughts, Chu Yang also understood where this thing came from!
This is not the Nine Tribulations Sword; to be precise, this is the sword soul of the Nine Tribulations Sword! Or rather sword intent!
It was when he used the destructive move that he stabbed the Nine Tribulations Sword into his heart, pouring his blood and inspiring the soul of the sword. This is also the beginning of the biggest secret in the Nine Tribulations Sword...
And it was this inspired sword soul that, somehow, brought me back to my youthful moment!
The last move of the Nine Tribulations Sword is a forbidden move. Die with the enemy, and kill yourself first, then the enemy! Only with such a determined will can it be displayed!
What Chu Yang didn't know was that this was one of the mysteries of the Nine Tribulations Sword!
The successive masters of the Nine Tribulations Sword only practiced according to the path of sword cultivation; they were not recognized by the Nine Tribulations Sword! Because if you completely treat yourself as a sword to practice...then, what will you get?
Swords are inherently ruthless. So driven by this, they will naturally choose ruthless swordsmanship!
Therefore, all the previous Nine Tribulations Sword Masters are just "sword slaves"! Including Chu Yang's previous life, he was just a sword slave! Slave of the sword!
It is the sword that uses the man, not the man who uses the sword!
But Chu Yang used his last move to destroy everything with my hard work!
Except for Chu Yang, no one who has obtained the Nine Tribulations Sword has ever dared to use this move! And when their lifespan reaches the end or they are accidentally killed, the Nine Tribulations Sword will automatically decompose and return to the state of fragments, scattered across the continent, quietly waiting for the real owner, hoping that one day, they can reach the glorious peak of the Nine Tribulations Sword and start its truly sacred destiny...
Therefore, Chu Yangzhe's desperate last move caused the sword soul to be fully activated and live in his dantian. From that time on, the number one divine object in the Nine Heavens Continent truly had a master!
That's why it accepted Chu Yang so easily.
It can be said that besides the person who created the Nine Tribulations Sword, Chu Yang is the first master of the Nine Tribulations Sword!
A veritable master of the Nine Tribulations Sword.
This is the real thing, risk your life and survive!
From this moment on, Chu Yang clearly knew that he would embark on a completely different path from his previous life!
Now, the sword soul of the Nine Tribulations Sword is like a crying baby waiting to be laid. It is urgently in need of the nourishment of the various fragments of the Nine Tribulations Sword and the aura of heaven and earth! This urgent emotion was urging Chu Yang to find the fragments of the Nine Tribulations Sword! Looking for the nutrients needed by the Nine Tribulations Sword...
Chu Yang's mind sank into his dantian, and he used his mind to wrap up the dim sword soul, and devoted himself to comforting it...
After a while, the Nine Tribulations Sword Intent seemed to sense Chu Yang's sincerity, and slowly calmed down. Although it was still somewhat reluctant, it no longer issued that longing call...
It seemed like a child who couldn't get his beloved toy, but was sensible enough not to forcefully make any noise. He just flattened his mouth, looked at his parents with tears in his eyes and felt aggrieved...
This Nine Tribulations Sword Soul is as lovable as a child.
Chu Yang felt a sense of pity in his heart. Under such a mood, he actually felt a sense of shame in his heart...
take controlExcited, he breathed a long sigh of relief. When he opened his eyes, he saw Shi Qianshan looking at him in front of him, with a hint of excitement deep in his eyes. He must have thought that Chu Yang's abnormality was caused by his injury. Seeing Chu Yang open his eyes, the excitement in his eyes flashed away, but he asked with concern: "Junior Brother Chu, what's wrong with you?"
"It's okay. It's just...I suddenly felt like farting just now, uh...but considering that you were right in front of me, senior brother, I was embarrassed, so I tried to hold it back..." Chu Yang looked at Shi Qianshan meaningfully and said seriously.
"Uh..." Shi Qianshan's expression changed, and he said calmly: "This... must be very uncomfortable..." I didn't know how to answer for a while. Should I persuade him to let him go... or just hold it in...
It doesn’t seem appropriate…
Tan Tan burst out laughing, but he felt it was inappropriate and did not dare to laugh loudly. In addition, his unique voice made the sound of laughter sound as dull as a fart...
